STM32CubeProgrammer 2.22.0 for Windows x64

The archive contains the unmodified command line programmer, its DLLs,
device database, flash loaders and signed STM32 USB bootloader driver.
The graphical application, Java runtime and debug probe software are omitted.

STM32CubeProgrammer and the driver are distributed under ST's SLA0048.
Third party libraries retain their own licenses. License texts and Qt's
third party notices are included in the archive's licenses directory.
Keep these files with the runtime when distributing the flasher.

The libraries are dynamically linked and can be replaced in the bin directory.
Their source code is available from the following upstream projects:

Qt 6.6.1
https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/6.6/6.6.1/submodules/
qtbase, qtdeclarative and qtserialport

OpenSSL 3.6.0
https://github.com/openssl/openssl/tree/openssl-3.6.0

Minizip
https://github.com/zlib-ng/minizip-ng

zlib
https://github.com/madler/zlib

XZ 5.8.1
https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/tree/v5.8.1

Zstandard 1.5.5
https://github.com/facebook/zstd/tree/v1.5.5

GCC runtime and MinGW winpthreads
https://gcc.gnu.org/releases.html
https://github.com/mingw-w64/mingw-w64
https://packages.msys2.org/packages/mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc-libs

STM32CubeProgrammer
https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeprog.html
